basis.method: Git tree paths, October 19 table membership, conventional index links, 74 bounded header inspections, verified selected GitHub PR metadata

semantics.role: Routing-only classification, not correctness or renewed authorization
semantics.censusSource: Old table membership, not commit-creation date
semantics.reviewDepth: Full-body review is not claimed by header_screened or path_only; full_body_pr_disposition_checked means its text and indicated PR disposition were checked, NOT a comprehensive current-runtime or every-claim recertification
semantics.authority: Only current_entrypoint is routing authority; source and owner consent always prevail
semantics.gitBlobSha: Git blob SHA of the exact candidate document bytes
semantics.verifiedPrRouting: Disposition expresses verified GitHub PR merge path, not current runtime recertification. merged_directly means the source PR merged; merged_via_integration means source PR closed unmerged and selected work was subsequently merged by integratedByPr.
